question: The Begumpuri mosque was built during the reign of Sultan ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Muhammad Bin Tughluq**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Begumpuri mosque was built during the reign of **Muhammad Bin Tughluq**, who ruled from 1325 to 1351.
 
• Muhammad Bin Tughluq was a ruler of the Tughluq dynasty, which was a Muslim dynasty of Turkic origin that ruled over the Delhi Sultanate.
 
• The mosque is located in Jahanpanah, one of the four cities of Delhi built by the Tughluq dynasty.
 
• The Begumpuri mosque is one of the largest and most significant mosques from the Tughluq period, showcasing Indo-Islamic architectural styles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Muhammad Bin Tughluq**

 
 
• Muhammad Bin Tughluq was known for his ambitious projects and administrative reforms, although many of them failed due to poor execution.
 
• He is also infamous for his decision to transfer the capital from Delhi to Daulatabad, which caused significant hardship to the population.
 
• His reign saw the expansion of the Delhi Sultanate to its greatest extent, covering most of the Indian subcontinent.
 
• Despite his failures, he was a learned ruler, proficient in multiple languages, and had a deep interest in philosophy, science, and the arts.
 
 
 
• **Delhi Sultanate**
 
 
• The Delhi Sultanate refers to the various Muslim dynasties that ruled over large parts of India from the 13th to the 16th centuries.
 
• It began with the establishment of the Mamluk dynasty in 1206 and ended with the emergence of the Mughal Empire in 1526.
 
• The Sultanate period is known for its cultural and architectural achievements, as well as the establishment of a centralized administrative system.
 
• Key dynasties of the Delhi Sultanate include the Mamluk, Khilji, Tughluq, Sayyid, and Lodi dynasties.
